How it works

From first call to
boarding pass.

01

Free profile evaluation

We map your marks, test scores, budget and goals to the right courses in your destination.

02

Test prep + shortlist

Coaching runs in parallel with a shortlist of 6–8 universities across safe, match and reach.

03

Applications & SOP

Applications, statement of purpose and references — reviewed until they're ready.

04

Offer & visa

Acceptance, financial documents, interview prep and the student visa file.

05

Pre-departure

Accommodation, forex, flights and a send-off briefing. Then you board.
